annotations.title: Brazilian CEP to address, IBGE code and area code

description: Expands a Brazilian postal code (CEP) into street, district, municipality, state, macro-region, IBGE municipality code, telephone area code and SIAFI code, with an automatic fallback to a second public base that returns latitude and longitude instead. Use it to autofill a shipping or billing address, to derive the IBGE code needed to join public statistical datasets, or to sanity-check an address a counterparty supplied. Do not use it to look up a company by CNPJ (use br_lookup_company_dossier). Read-only and idempotent: nothing is written and the same CEP returns the same address until the postal base changes. It queries external public bases, so a well-formed but unassigned CEP returns found:false with success:true and a CEP without 8 digits returns valid:false, never an exception. Costs 0.01 USDC per call via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. Note that when the fallback source answers, regiao, ibgeCode, ddd and siafiCode are absent and coordinates is present instead.

cep.description: Brazilian postal code with 8 digits. Punctuation is accepted and stripped, so both '01310-100' and '01310100' work.

name: br_lookup_postal_address

error.description: Stable machine-readable failure code, present only when the call itself was rejected. Common values: 'bad_request' (malformed JSON or no operation supplied), 'invalid_payment' / 'settlement_failed' (x402 verification or settlement refused, returned with HTTP 402), 'B2B_KEY_INVALID' and 'B2B_QUOTA_EXCEEDED' (B2B X-API-Key path), 'invalid_wafermap_signature' (marketplace HMAC path). A document that simply fails validation is NOT an error: the call returns success:true with valid:false inside the result block.

locationIntel.description: Postal-code intelligence. The primary source is ViaCEP; on failure it falls back to a second public base, and the fallback payload carries coordinates but omits regiao, siafiCode, ddd and complemento.

cep.description: The postal code as returned by the source, usually formatted NNNNN-NNN.

complemento.description: Range or side-of-street complement, when the source provides one.

coordinates.description: Latitude and longitude, returned by the fallback source only.

ddd.description: Telephone area code. Primary source only.

error.description: Portuguese reason, present only when valid is false or found is false.

found.description: Present and false only when both sources failed to resolve an otherwise well-formed CEP.

ibgeCode.description: IBGE municipality code, the key to join with any Brazilian public statistical dataset. Primary source only.

logradouro.description: Street name. Null for codes that cover a whole municipality.

regiao.description: Macro-region, for example Sudeste or Sul. Primary source only.

siafiCode.description: SIAFI municipality code used by federal accounting systems. Primary source only.

valid.description: false when the input did not contain exactly 8 digits, in which case no lookup was attempted.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the failure, in Portuguese. Safe to log or surface to a human operator.

processingTimeMs.description: Edge processing time in milliseconds, excluding payment settlement. Mirrored in the X-Processing-Time-Ms response header.

success.description: true when the request was processed and paid for, independently of whether the CEP resolved.

suggestedNextSteps.description: Chaining hints for autonomous agents: sibling paid APIs in the same suite that are commonly called right after this one. Purely advisory, never required.

endpoint.description: Absolute HTTPS endpoint of the suggested follow-up API.

priceUsdc.description: Price of the suggested follow-up call, in USDC.

tool.description: Tool name of the suggested follow-up API.

when.description: Condition under which the follow-up call is worth making.
